subject: Deployment mode & pricing - Acme Corp (follow-up)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & next steps

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of needs (from our conversation):
- Primary workload: multi-turn chat assistant + document summarization pipeline.
- Peak latency target: <= 300ms p95 for chat flows.
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~10-15 QPS, peak bursts to ~50 QPS.
- Data sensitivity: some PII; need SOC2 evidence and customer-managed keys.
- Retention: logs + traces for 90 days; user data stored in their DB.

Deployment mode considerations:
- Hosted API: fastest path to production, pay-as-you-go per-token, no infra commitments. Good for early launch and unpredictable traffic.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and lower per-token unit costs at scale. Requires monthly/annual commits (we can model 3/6/12-month options).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): for strict isolation & KMS/HSM integrations. Higher setup time and platform fee, suited for regulated workloads.

Requested from your side:
1) Confirm which deployment mode you prefer to prioritize (hosted -> evaluate, dedicated -> sizing, private -> security review).
2) Share rough monthly token volume and % of chat vs batch summarization (ballpark is fine).
3) Any procurement timelines or preferred contract length (monthly/annual) we should know about.

I've attached a quick cost model that compares per-token hosted economics vs three dedicated commit bands and a private deployment estimate. See attachment: acme-cost-modeling-20260321.xlsx.

Next steps:
- If you're open, I'll schedule a short call early next week to walk through the numbers with Marissa (pricing lead) and map to expected QPS.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachment: acme-cost-modeling-20260321.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acme.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & next steps

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying points from our side:
- We're leaning toward Dedicated for cost predictability, but want to validate the break-even vs hosted per-token for our baseline traffic (10-15 QPS).
- For the private/VPC option: we need KMS + audit log retention for 7 years; can Redwood support long-term retention? Also curious about uplift in platform fees for private.
- Procurement: we typically do annual contracts and procurement sign-off in ~6 weeks. An annual committed option looks preferable.

Can you include in the model: expected monthly spend at 10 QPS steady state, and a 50 QPS burst profile? Also please show a 12-month commit cadence (monthly amortized).

Appreciate it —
Sasha
Sr. Product Manager | Acme Corp
Sasha.Ivanov@acme.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & next steps

Sasha —

Thanks — I've updated the attached model with the scenarios you asked for and added a short explainer PDF (redwood-pricing-summary-20260321.pdf). Highlights:

High-level assumptions I used (see attachment for per-token math):
- Chat model baseline: 16k context, average 60 input tokens / 140 output tokens per interaction.
- Batch summarization: avg 2k input tokens -> 500 output tokens.
- Month = 30 days.

Scenarios (monthly, rough):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): at 10 QPS steady (approx 26M tokens/mo), estimated cost = ~$12k/mo. 50 QPS bursts (approx 130M tokens/mo) scale linearly; estimated cost = ~$60k/mo. No commitments.
- Dedicated (12-mo commit, medium band): amortized capacity pricing reduces per-token equivalent by ~45% vs hosted at steady-state volumes. For your 10 QPS steady, dedicated breaks even at ~2-3 month commit amortization and yields ~30-40% savings over hosted across the year (exacts in the spreadsheet).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): platform fee + infra. Upfront setup ~1-2 months work; platform fee uplift ~25-40% vs dedicated depending on KMS/HSM integrations and support SLA. Retention for 7 years is supported; we'll need to scope storage egress and archival.

Notes on procurement & contract length: we offer discounts for 12- and 24-month commits and can include flexible burst credits for seasonal spikes. I flagged procurement timelines to our contracts team and they can produce a draft SOW once you confirm target commit band.

I'll propose a 30-minute review next Tue 10am PT to walk through the spreadsheet with Marissa and align on commit sizing. Does that work?

Thanks —
Aditya

Attachment: redwood-pricing-summary-20260321.pdf (2 pages)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acme.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & next steps

Hi Sasha —

Looping in a couple of dedicated-capacity specifics so you have the concrete options before our call:

Dedicated commit bands (examples):
- Small (1-4 GPUs equivalent): good for pilots; 2-4 week spin-up, limited burst headroom.
- Medium (5-16 GPUs equivalent): predictable throughput for production apps; autoscaling policies and burst credits included. Typical customers in this range see 30-45% lower unit cost vs hosted.
- Large (17+ GPUs equivalent): for sustained high throughput; custom SLAs and capacity isolation.

What we need from you to size:
1) Typical request mix (chat vs batch) - you mentioned ~70% chat earlier.
2) Average tokens per interaction for chat (we used 200 tokens total / interaction as a proxy).
3) Desired p95 latency SLO.

If the Tue 10am PT slot works, I'll bring a sample commit schedule showing monthly amortization + burst credit mechanics. If that time doesn't work, propose 11am PT or Wed morning.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Pricing & Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
